name: The Miracle and the Sleeper
justification: Two numbers in, one number out, and the whole problem is a single maximisation observation.
solution_sketch: If r >= 2l, take b = floor(r/2)+1 and a = r to get (r-1)/2, which is the best possible remainder below b. Otherwise b must exceed r/2 so a = r, b = l is optimal and the answer is r-l.
